parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two relatives who have coeliac disease.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the whisking method and make a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different method of
cooking from the following list:
boiling, microwave, pressure cooking, shallow frying, steaming.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a savoury dish using yeast and make a batch of small cakes or a tray bake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two adult friends who are trying to lose
weight.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using oats and make a cake using the creaming method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes suitable for a packed meal for two active
teenagers. The dishes must be suitable to be eaten cold.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using pasta and a dish using fresh fruit.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes that are suitable for serving at a 10-year-old’s birthday
party. One of the dishes should be a decorated birthday cake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two neighbours who are both pregnant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using a spice and make some savoury muffins.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes each to show the use of a different high
biological value (HBV) protein.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cold sweet dish that requires setting and make a hot dessert.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two lacto-vegetarians.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a savoury dish using a coating batter and make a sweet dish to demonstrate the use of
a piping bag.
